data.name: Diabolic Boon
data.description: If a tyrant chooses to gain the services of a fiendish servant with his fiendish boon ability, he must choose a fiendish animal or a creature with the lawful and evil subtypes. If a tyrant chooses to be able to enhance their weapon with his fiendish boon ability, he can grant it the axiomatic, rather than anarchic, weapon quality. This ability alters fiendish boon.
